summary: Completed comprehensive testing of HR & GA Agreement Management System. Backend APIs are fully functional with minor expiry calculation issue. Frontend authentication, dashboard, and vendor management working well. Session management needs improvement for better user experience.

minor_bugs.issue: Expiry status calculation not working correctly for agreements expiring within 30 days
minor_bugs.impact: Agreements that should be marked as 'expiring_soon' are being marked as 'active'

integration_issues.issue: JWT tokens appear to expire quickly causing frequent redirects to login

passed_tests: Admin login with default credentials (admin@company.com / Admin123!)
Dashboard displays correct stats (total agreements, active, expiring soon, expired, total vendors)
Vendor management - Create, edit, delete vendors working
Agreement creation with vendor selection, category, dates, description
Agreement listing with search and filters working
User interface design following 'Organic & Earthy' theme with Deep Teal colors
All interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes
Backend API endpoints returning correct status codes
CRUD operations for vendors and agreements
action_item_for_main_agent: 1. Fix expiry status calculation logic to properly handle timezone differences. 2. Investigate JWT token expiration settings to improve session management. 3. Consider implementing token refresh mechanism for better user experience.
